_about: EP 01, invisible to ChatGPT (9:19.35–9:42.75): Martin, Sarah, Martin. Starts on the hook, ends on the punchline before Sarah's next question.
output: ~/Downloads/IG Story - Be the source (invisible to ChatGPT).mp4
spans: The major AI crawlers don’t execute JavaScript at all.
So a page can rank in Google,
show up in AI Overviews, | and still be completely empty | to ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity.
So we could be invisible to them and never notice,
Right. | Google looks fine, so nobody thinks to check.
